WITH payout_eur AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    cd.year_num,
    cd.quarter_num,
    p.gross_amount / er.rate AS gross_eur,
    p.fee_amount / er.rate AS fee_eur
  FROM payouts p
  JOIN calendar_days cd ON cd.calendar_date = CAST(p.paid_at AS date)
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = CAST(p.paid_at AS date)
  WHERE p.status = 'paid'
    AND cd.year_num IN (2024, 2025)
),
quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    year_num,
    quarter_num,
    SUM(gross_eur) AS gross_volume_eur,
    SUM(fee_eur) AS fee_revenue_eur
  FROM payout_eur
  GROUP BY year_num, quarter_num
)
SELECT
  (year_num::text || '-Q' || quarter_num::text) AS quarter,
  ROUND(gross_volume_eur, 2) AS gross_volume_eur,
  ROUND(fee_revenue_eur, 2) AS fee_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * fee_revenue_eur / NULLIF(gross_volume_eur, 0), 2) AS take_rate_pct,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * fee_revenue_eur / NULLIF(gross_volume_eur, 0)
    - LAG(100.0 * fee_revenue_eur / NULLIF(gross_volume_eur, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY year_num, quarter_num),
    2
  ) AS take_rate_change_pp
FROM quarterly
ORDER BY year_num, quarter_num
